(1) the statistical approach to the construction of ab initio nuclear models provides a robust framework for analyzing the link to nuclear observables, and that (2) the statistical approach is essential for quantifying the uncertainty in the predictions of ab initio models.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of statistical models for atomic nuclei, which provide a quantitative description of their bulk properties, and with the development of methods to extract information about the nuclear interaction from these models.
the development of ab initio models of nuclei that can be calibrated against experimental data.
the development of models of atomic nuclei that can be used to describe nuclear structure, nuclear reactions, and astrophysical processes.
